items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: He and I got to be buddy buddies for a while.

ctx.x: Freddie King came down here, and he was on the cause. He was living on the causeway at Marino's Motel, and he and I got to be buddy buddies for a while. He was here because his cause broke down.

items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: But I'm Loop was on him, period.

ctx.x: I think that was the song we haven't told you.
No, no, not Loop. No, Lord and My Baby. Lord and My Baby. Okay, that was a tune that you could hear Ray Charles. Ray Charles finally got into being Ray Charles. But I'm Loop was on him, period.
Yeah, and we didn't talk about that.
